executable_actions.rationale: The failed gate is a deterministic current-layer manifest/tool-protocol defect. Bind simulation.source_identity_sha256 to the current exact identity document, bind compile_authority and each ordered command authority_refs to the identity's exact Vivado export facts, and retain only executables already authorized by the current tool profile or cited export. This is causally distinct from the completed connected-kernel replay and preserves all immutable functional inputs and exact-board source hashes.

Its report rejects simulation.source_identity_sha256, compile_authority, ordered-command authority_refs, and command executable authorization against the current exact board identity and Vivado export facts.

Because case_axi_ddr_interface failed, case_vcs_functional_sim and case_vcs_evidence_analyzer are dependency-blocked as acceptance evidence. The older VCS lifecycle trace is therefore diagnostic-only and cannot establish board functional, numeric, AXI/DDR, runtime-loader, complete-weight-consumption, or output correctness.

The supplied completed lower-layer capability is fresh, hash-bound, and closed: 416 accepted trace records, ingress complete, egress accepted_count=1792, terminal egress last=true, and boundary liveness pass. It must not be rerun or repaired in this turn.

The alleged board-to-kernel contradiction is not an operational lower-layer reopen trigger: the current authoritative debug closure classifies the failure as a verification-capability gap, and the diagnostic trace has incomplete CCTG boundary coverage while its exact-board authority binding is rejected.

The exact sample wrapper identity and simulation source closure already pass identity checking. The repair must update only derived manifest/compile authority provenance, never substitute a wrapper or alter wrapper/source hashes.
